reviews.assumption: FRANK/Harness effect retries can be modeled as deterministic local lifecycle transitions with idempotency handled only by local ledger state.
reviews.ancestry: FRANK/Harness-derived requirement; not independent evidence by itself.
reviews.counterhypothesis: A local durable lifecycle is sufficient without remote operation identity or reconciliation.
reviews.adversarial_result: Counterhypothesis fails in the minimal indistinguishable PREPARED worlds: RETRY duplicates one world; ABSTAIN loses the other.
reviews.refinement: Preserve local lifecycle, but add stable effect identity/fingerprint and an explicit delivery/recovery contract. When remote coordination/reconciliation is absent, expose UNCERTAIN instead of inventing DONE.

reviews.assumption: The finding requires a new ClayCode surface primitive.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Existing EffectIntent constraints/type-effect metadata plus runtime ABI can represent the mechanism without syntax change.
reviews.next_test: Compile a real effectful application/FRANK component through parser->typed IR->lowering with the recovery contract; change language semantics only if that executable path cannot express it.
